title: known positive: tests run on every pull_request with no path filter

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pytest

title: legitimate exception: changed-files gating with dorny/paths-filter

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: changes
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'src/**'
      - run: pytest

title: legitimate exception: job gated by an if on another job's change-detection output

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  info:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./detect-changes.sh
  tests:
    needs: info
    if: needs.info.outputs.run_tests == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: pytest
